name: Admin LinkedIn Content Module
description: Admin manages freeform LinkedIn posts at /panel/linkedin (sidebar section ProjectApp content): connection card shows OAuth status (connect/reconnect popup, token expiry date via GET /api/linkedin/status/), posts list from GET /api/linkedin/posts/ with status chips (Borrador/Programado/Publicado/Fallido), create/edit modal (commentary max 3000, optional image, optional schedule datetime) posting to /api/linkedin/posts/create/ | :id/update/, publish-now with confirm via POST /api/linkedin/posts/:id/publish/ (502 error surfaces inline), delete with confirm via /api/linkedin/posts/:id/delete/. Scheduled posts are published by Huey (ETA + minute sweep) server-side.
knownGaps: Scheduled auto-publish is a server-side Huey task — covered by backend tests, not browser E2E
